description: Source code implementing the IActivityManager interface, including the BpActivityManager class with methods for content URI access, UID observation, permission checks, and logging, within the Android framework.

classes.name: BpActivityManager
classes.description: A proxy class for IActivityManager interface, providing implementations for remote procedure calls such as openContentUri, registerUidObserver, and permission checks.

methods.name: openContentUri
methods.description: Opens a content URI and returns a file descriptor if successful.

methods.name: registerUidObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for UID-related events.

methods.name: registerUidObserverForUids
methods.description: Registers an observer for specific UIDs.

methods.name: addUidToObserver
methods.description: Adds a UID to an existing observer.

methods.name: removeUidFromObserver
methods.description: Removes a UID from an observer.

methods.name: isUidActive
methods.description: Checks if a UID is active.

methods.name: getUidProcessState
methods.description: Retrieves the process state of a UID.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a permission is granted for a process.

methods.name: logFgsApiBegin
methods.description: Logs the beginning of a foreground service API call.

methods.name: logFgsApiEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of a foreground service API call.

methods.name: logFgsApiStateChanged
methods.description: Logs a change in the state of a foreground service API.
